List webhooks
Copy page

Returns the active Webhooks for your team.

You can paginate through the results using the cursor parameter.

GET
/
v0
/
webhooks
Try it
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Query Parameters
​
cursor
string

The cursor to paginate through the results

Minimum string length: 1
​
limit
integerdefault:25

The number of results to return

Required range: 1 <= x <= 200
Response
200 - application/json

List of webhooks

​
data
object[]required

The list of webhooks

Show child attributes

​
hasMore
booleanrequired

Whether there are more results to paginate through

​
nextCursor
string | nullrequired

The cursor to paginate through the next set of results
